description: STATE-05 id-correlation under interleaving. A notify_status_update arrives BETWEEN an objects.query request (id=4654) and its matching {result,id} reply. A correct client must NOT consume the notification as the query answer — it has no id and must route to the status stream; only the frame whose id==4654 resolves the deferred. Replay 'frames' in order through FakeWebSocket after sending a query with id 4654.
